description: This file implements command handling for model selection in an auto-reply system, including functions to build model provider data, parse command arguments, and generate responses for the /models command.

methods.name: buildModelsProviderData
methods.description: Builds provider/model data from configuration and catalog, returning a structured object with provider info, default model, and display names.

methods.name: formatModelsAvailableHeader
methods.description: Formats a header string indicating available models for a provider, including human-readable provider label.

methods.name: resolveModelsCommandReply
methods.description: Processes the /models command input, retrieves model data, and generates an appropriate reply payload with model listings or provider selection.

methods.name: handleModelsCommand
methods.description: Main command handler for /models, coordinating authorization, argument parsing, and reply generation.
